class_size.description: Businesses, entries and exits by ANZSIC class, subdivision and division × employment size, FY2024-25, all states summed (8165.0 cube 2 of the Jul 2021 to Jun 2025 release). size_band: nonemp (non-employing), 1-4, 5-19, 20-199, 200+ employees or total. Subdivision and division rows are sums of perturbed class cells, so they differ slightly from published totals. Rates: entries or exits per 100 businesses operating at the start of the year (derived). Classes the ABS codes as unknown (9999) are left out.

UNKNOWN = industry currently unknown; TOT = all industries.
